article.story: Indiana Pacers vs. New Orleans Pelicans New Orleans; Wednesday, 8 p.m. EDT LINE: Pacers -3.5; over/under is 240.5 BOTTOM LINE: The New Orleans Pelicans host the Indiana Pacers for the season opener. New Orleans went 26-56 overall last season while going 17-24 at home. The Pelicans averaged 115.5 points per game while allowing opponents to score 120.0 last season. Indiana finished 19-63 overall, 15-37 in Eastern Conference play and 8-33 on the road a season ago. The Pacers averaged 7.4 steals, 4.6 blocks and 13.8 turnovers per game last season.
